description: This file defines the EmployeeReportingMethodService class within the OrangeHRM system, providing methods for managing employee reporting relationships such as supervisors and subordinates. It interacts with a Data Access Object (DAO) for database operations and includes logic for handling employee reporting hierarchy data.

classes.name: EmployeeReportingMethodService
classes.description: Service class for handling employee reporting hierarchy operations such as retrieving supervisors and subordinates.

methods.name: getEmployeeReportingMethodDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the EmployeeReportingMethodDao instance used for database operations.

methods.name: setEmployeeReportingMethodDao
methods.description: Sets the EmployeeReportingMethodDao instance, allowing dependency injection.

methods.name: getImmediateSupervisorListForEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves a list of immediate supervisors for a specific employee based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getImmediateSupervisorListCountForEmployee
methods.description: Returns the count of immediate supervisors matching the filter for a specific employee.

methods.name: getSubordinateListForEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves a list of subordinates for a specific employee based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSubordinateListCountForEmployee
methods.description: Returns the count of subordinates matching the filter for a specific employee.

methods.name: getAccessibleAndAvailableSupervisorsIdCombinedList
methods.description: Combines accessible supervisor IDs by removing already assigned ones.

methods.name: getAlreadyAssignedSupervisorsSubordinatesAndSelfIdCombinedList
methods.description: Merges lists of supervisors, subordinates, and includes the employee's own ID.
